scripts.check: pnpm run --silent check:ruff-format && pnpm run --silent check:ruff-lint && pnpm run --silent check:mypy && pnpm run --silent check:import-linter && pnpm run --silent check:pytest && pnpm run --silent check:prettier && pnpm run --silent check:eslint && pnpm run --silent check:tsc && pnpm run --silent check:vitest
scripts.check:ruff-format: uv run ruff format --check backend packages voice || { echo "check failed: ruff-format" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check:ruff-lint: uv run ruff check backend packages voice || { echo "check failed: ruff-lint" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check:mypy: uv run mypy || { echo "check failed: mypy" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check:import-linter: PYTHONPATH=backend uv run lint-imports || { echo "check failed: import-linter" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check:pytest: uv run pytest || { echo "check failed: pytest" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check:prettier: prettier --check "apps/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,json}" package.json || { echo "check failed: prettier" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check:eslint: eslint --config apps/web/eslint.config.js apps/web || { echo "check failed: eslint" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check:tsc: tsc --noEmit -p apps/web || { echo "check failed: tsc" >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.check:vitest: vitest run --passWithNoTests || { echo "check failed: vitest" >&2; exit 1; }
